items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: Sure, they were okay. But I didn’t really love them the way I love jazz.

ctx.x: So there was that going on but then you had Johnny Ray doing “Cry.” Did those kinds of things, Dean Martin, Perry Como, did they appeal to you?
Sure, they were okay. But I didn’t really love them the way I love jazz.
